patterns.note: The homepage features a full-bleed hero image with text overlay, which transitions into a dynamic, irregular grid of image-text cards for article previews.
A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing prominent, all-caps sans-serif fonts for titles and navigation with a classic serif font for article details and body text.
The design relies on a high-contrast monochrome palette of black and white, with color introduced exclusively through photography and embedded media.
The 'PW MAGAZINE' logo transforms from a large, centered element in the hero section to a smaller, sticky header positioned in the top-left corner upon scrolling.
Content sections are presented as a varied grid of image-text cards, where each card features a distinct image above a title and subtitle, creating a magazine-like layout.

technique_notes: The initial hero section utilizes a full-viewport background image with text overlaid, which scrolls up and out of view to reveal the main content area.
A central branding element dynamically resizes and repositions itself from the page's center to a fixed position in the top-left corner, becoming a persistent header after a specific scroll depth.
Article previews are structured within a flexible grid system, where each item consists of an image positioned above its corresponding text, without any interactive hover states or animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, all-caps sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) are paired with smaller, classic serif body text and even smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels for details.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and between major content blocks, transitioning to a balanced density within the article grid cards.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its strong editorial aesthetic, achieved through a stark black-and-white palette, a dynamic magazine-style content grid, and a unique transforming sticky header that re-positions the main logo. It feels less like a typical website and more like a curated digital art publication.
